errors.generic: The action did not complete. Try again.

errors.MKT-ERR-VALIDATION: The request is not valid. Check the version and the reason.
errors.MKT-ERR-PACK-VERSION-UNKNOWN: The pack or the version is not in the version registry.
errors.MKT-ERR-PACK-NOT-PUBLISHED: The target version is not published and cannot be activated.
errors.MKT-ERR-PACK-ALREADY-ACTIVE: This version is already active for the legal entity. There is nothing to change.
errors.MKT-ERR-PACK-ROLLBACK-INSTANT: The rollback cannot take effect before the activation of the version it replaces.
errors.MKT-ERR-PACK-ACTIVATION-STATE: The request is no longer pending. Refresh the page.
errors.MKT-ERR-IDEMPOTENCY-MISMATCH: This request was already sent with different details. Reopen the dialog.
errors.MKT-ERR-SOD-VIOLATION: This decision is not allowed: the checker must hold Platform.DesignAuthority and be a different person from whoever made the request.
errors.PLT-ERR-SELF-APPROVAL: You cannot approve or reject a request that you or your principal made. Another checker is needed.
